named-query.name: Vehicle.findByPlate
named-query.query: select v from Vehicle v where v.plateNumber = ?1

named-query.name: Order.findBySparePartCode
named-query.query: SELECT o FROM Order o JOIN o.orderLines ol where ol.sparePart.code = ?1

named-query.name: Order.findByProviderNif
named-query.query: select o from Order o join Provider p on p.id = o.provider.id where o.provider.nif = ?1

named-query.name: Order.findByCode
named-query.query: select o from Order o where o.code = ?1

named-query.name: Provider.findByName
named-query.query: select p from Provider p where p.name = ?1

named-query.name: Provider.findByNameMailPhone
named-query.query: select p from Provider p where p.name = ?1 and p.email = ?2 and p.phone = ?3

named-query.name: Provider.findByNif
named-query.query: select p from Provider p where p.nif = ?1

named-query.name: Provider.findBySparePartCode
named-query.query: select p from Provider p join p.supplies s where s.sparePart.code = ?1

named-query.name: WorkOrder.findByIds
named-query.query: select w from WorkOrder w where w.id in ?1

named-query.name: WorkOrder.findNotInvoicedWorkOrdersByClientNif
named-query.query: select w from WorkOrder w join Vehicle v on w.vehicle.id = v.id join Client c on v.client.id = c.id where c.nif like ?1 and w.state = uo.ri.cws.domain.WorkOrder.WorkOrderState.FINISHED

named-query.name: PaymentMean.findByInvoiceId
named-query.query: select m from Invoice f join f.workOrders w join w.vehicle.client c join c.paymentMeans m where f.id = ?1

named-query.name: Mechanic.findByNif
named-query.query: select m from Mechanic m where m.nif = ?1

named-query.name: Mechanic.findWith1WorkOrder
named-query.query: select m from Mechanic m where m.

named-query.name: Mechanic.findAll
named-query.query: select m from Mechanic m

named-query.name: Supply.findByNifAndCode
named-query.query: select s from Supply s join s.provider p join s.sparePart sp where p.nif = ?1 and sp.code = ?2

named-query.name: Supply.findByProviderNif
named-query.query: select s from Supply s join s.provider p where p.nif = ?1

named-query.name: Supply.findBySparePartCode
named-query.query: select s from Supply s join SparePart sp where s.sparePart.code = ?1

named-query.name: Invoice.findByNumber
named-query.query: select f from Invoice f where f.number = ?1

named-query.name: Invoice.getNextInvoiceNumber
named-query.query: select cast( coalesce(max(f.number) + 1, 1L) as bigint ) from Invoice f

named-query.name: SparePart.findByCode
named-query.query: select sp from SparePart sp where sp.code = ?1

named-query.name: SparePart.findByDescription
named-query.query: SELECT sp FROM SparePart sp LEFT JOIN sp.substitutions ts WHERE sp.description = ?1

named-query.name: SparePart.findUnderStock
named-query.query: SELECT sp FROM SparePart sp WHERE sp.stock < sp.minStock

named-query.name: SparePart.findUnderStockNotPending
named-query.query: SELECT sp FROM SparePart sp WHERE sp.stock < sp.minStock AND sp.code NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT ol.sparePart.code FROM Order o JOIN o.orderLines ol WHERE o.state = uo.ri.cws.domain.Order.OrderState.PENDING )

named-query.name: SparePart.findOverStock
named-query.query: SELECT sp FROM SparePart sp WHERE sp.stock > sp.maxStock
